review.title: LP-05: restore production OpenAPI handoff parity
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: complete three-commit base-to-head diff and all seven changed files
SPA shell route registration and Swagger visibility boundary
production-equivalent static-host and complete OpenAPI parity regression
frozen OpenAPI digest and existing full-document compatibility checks
exact-head GitHub metadata and required checks
excluded_scope: production endpoints, credentials, deployment, handoff delivery, release and merge execution

forward_risk_review.surface: Browser shell route and machine API contract separation
forward_risk_review.reason: The change deliberately removes six browser-only routes from runtime Swagger while preserving their HTTP behavior, so an over-broad hide or a Web regression would affect the production contract.
checks: traced all six route registrations and verified only their shared schema metadata changed
verified the Web-enabled regression exercises every shell URL, static asset caching, CSP and both API/UI 404 boundaries
verified the same regression compares the complete runtime document to the frozen document before asserting all six shell paths are absent
confirmed the exact-head verify and candidate jobs completed successfully

forward_risk_review.surface: Complete OpenAPI digest and handoff authority preservation
forward_risk_review.reason: The fix exists to restore handoff generation without weakening the complete-document authority or allowing browser routes to mask business API drift.
checks: independently recomputed the frozen canonical document digest with sorted JSON plus the required trailing newline
verified the compatibility function still validates required operations and hashes the complete document
verified existing tests mutate request body, components, parameters and security and require each mutation to change the digest
confirmed no handoff, credential, production, database or release implementation changed in the PR

decision.rationale: The exact-head implementation is narrowly scoped to the six enumerated SPA routes, preserves their browser behavior, and adds a production-equivalent full-document equality regression. The frozen digest and complete-contract fail-closed boundary remain intact, and both required exact-head CI jobs pass. No critical finding remains under AGILE_REVIEWED policy.

summary: APPROVE / READY for exact head ef4485b6d25c9f799c9422d45b96b6e38c78c3e1. The six SPA shell routes remain served but are excluded from Swagger, and the Web-enabled runtime OpenAPI is required to equal the frozen complete document. Review is read-only and did not merge or touch production.

change_map.change: Apply one immutable schema.hide route option to exactly six existing shell registrations.
change_map.external_behavior: Browser URLs keep serving the shell but are no longer advertised as machine API operations.
change_map.validation: Manual route-by-route diff trace plus exact-head static-host regression in GitHub CI.

change_map.change: A Web-enabled app now compares its complete runtime OpenAPI object and canonical digest with the frozen document.
change_map.external_behavior: Any visible shell route or real API/schema/security drift fails the parity gate.
change_map.validation: Full object equality, frozen digest assertion, explicit hidden-path assertions and existing mutation coverage.

risks.description: Future browser shell routes must explicitly remain outside the machine API contract.
risks.mitigation: Preserve the full Web-enabled runtime-to-frozen OpenAPI equality regression when adding routes.
